headline: ARC-2 gold cutoff reaches 55 as two teams slip out

sections.text: The score needed for 15th place rose 1.94 in the past day to 55.00. Kajetan Schweighofer is first outside the gold places, 16th at 54.44 and 0.56 short.
Schweighofer fell from 12th to 16th, while matu997 slipped from 13th to 17th. Both scores were unchanged as the cutoff moved above them.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
